description: Shared Jira Service Management (JSM) connection: HTTP Basic auth (email + API token) over the servicedeskapi surface (/rest/servicedeskapi/...) for creating and commenting on customer requests, plus the core Jira API slice (/rest/api/3/...) JSM itself has no equivalent for (JQL search, field updates). Separate from jira_resource -- see README for why.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource registration key. Other components reference it via this name.

email_env_var.label: Email Env Var
email_env_var.description: Env var holding the Atlassian account email (Basic auth username).

api_token_env_var.label: Api Token Env Var
api_token_env_var.description: Env var holding an Atlassian API token.

site_domain.label: Site Domain
site_domain.description: Atlassian site subdomain only, e.g. 'mysite' for mysite.atlassian.net (no https://, no trailing slash).

name: Jira Service Management Resource
